The Railway Recruitment Boards (RRB) have opened a special CCAA Modification Window 2026 for candidates under CEN No. 08/2024, popularly known as RRB Group D recruitment. The window is open from 17 June 2026 (00:01 hrs) to 23 June 2026 (23:59 hrs), allowing eligible Course Completed Act Apprentice (CCAA) candidates who appeared in the CBT but had not entered their NCVT examination marks to update this information online before the deadline closes.

This is a one-time, time-bound opportunity. If you are a CCAA candidate and missed filling in your NCVT marks at the time of applying, this article explains exactly who can use this window, what you need to update, the step-by-step process, and what happens if you miss the deadline.

Click Here: RRB CCAA Modification Window 2026

RRB CCAA Modification Window 2026 - Key Highlights

This section gives a quick snapshot of the most important facts about the modification window the recruitment body, notification number, opening and closing dates, and who it applies to so you can confirm at a glance whether this update concerns you.

Detail Information
Recruitment Body Railway Recruitment Boards (RRB)
Notification Number CEN No. 08/2024 (Level-1 / Group D)
Total Vacancies (CEN 08/2024) 32,438
Window Opens 17 June 2026, 00:01 hrs
Window Closes 23 June 2026, 23:59 hrs
Eligible Candidates CCAA candidates who appeared in CBT but did not furnish NCVT marks
Official Notice Date 16 June 2026
Purpose Updating NCVT certificate details and marks for CCAA quota benefits

Who Are CCAAs and Why Does This Update Matter?

Before looking at eligibility and steps, it helps to understand who qualifies as a CCAA and why updating NCVT details carries real weight in the RRB Group D selection process.

Course Completed Act Apprentices (CCAAs) are candidates who have completed their apprenticeship training in a Railway Establishment under the Apprentices Act. CCAAs trained in a Railway Establishment receive two specific advantages over general candidates in the RRB Group D selection process:

  • NCVT marks weightage: Marks obtained in the National Council for Vocational Training (NCVT) examination are given due weightage while preparing the final merit list after the CBT.
  • PET exemption: CCAAs trained in Railway Establishments are fully exempt from the Physical Efficiency Test (PET), which is mandatory for all other Group D candidates.

Because these two benefits directly affect a candidate's final merit position and exam process, any CCAA candidate who has not yet recorded their NCVT marks needs to act within this window to remain eligible for them.

Why Was the CCAA Modification Window Opened?

This section explains the background that led RRB to open this window, helping candidates understand whether their specific situation matches the criteria.

The matter traces back to an earlier notice dated 3 February 2025, which addressed two categories of CCAA applicants:

  • Category 1: CCAAs who had already received their National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) from NCVT at the time of application were instructed to enter their training duration, certificate details, and marks directly in the online form.
  • Category 2: CCAAs who had appeared for the NCVT examination before the application deadline, but whose results were not yet declared, were advised to fill in their exam date and flag the result as "awaited."

Despite this earlier instruction, a number of eligible CCAA candidates who went on to appear in the CBT still had not entered their NCVT marks in the system. To allow these candidates to claim the benefits they are entitled to under the CCAA quota, RRB has now opened this dedicated modification window from 17 to 23 June 2026.

Who Is Eligible for the RRB CCAA Modification Window 2026?

This section lists the exact eligibility conditions, since only candidates meeting all three criteria together can use this facility.

A candidate can use this modification window only if all three of the following conditions are met:

  1. The candidate appeared in the Computer Based Test (CBT) under CEN No. 08/2024.
  2. The candidate had not entered their NCVT examination marks in the original online application.
  3. The candidate had indicated the date of their NCVT examination in the application, typically with a "results awaited" flag.

If even one of these conditions is not met for instance, if you did not appear in the CBT, or if your NCVT marks were already filled in correctly at the time of application you are not eligible to use this window.

What Can Be Updated in the Modification Window?

This part covers exactly what information eligible candidates are permitted to add or change during the 17–23 June window.

During this window, eligible CCAA candidates can:

  • Fill in NCVT certificate details, if not entered earlier
  • Update the marks obtained in the NCVT examination
  • Enter National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) details

Once submitted, RRB uses this information to calculate the applicable NCVT weightage for the candidate's CCAA quota benefit, which then feeds into the preparation of the final merit list.

How to Update NCVT Details: Step-by-Step Process

This section walks through the practical process of making the update, from logging in to final submission.

  1. Visit the official RRB website for your respective zone, or the centralised application portal as indicated in your candidature.
  2. Log in to your CEN 08/2024 application using your registration number and password/date of birth.
  3. Navigate to the "Modification Window" or "CCAA/NCVT Details Update" section.
  4. Enter your NCVT certificate number, marks obtained, date of examination, training duration, and any other requested details.
  5. Upload supporting documents if the system prompts you to do so.
  6. Carefully review every entry before submission, since corrections cannot be made once the window closes.
  7. Submit the form before 23 June 2026, 23:59 hrs, and save or download the confirmation/screenshot for your records.

Always complete this process only through the official RRB website for your zone or the application portal linked in the official notice. Avoid third-party websites claiming to offer "application update services," as these are not authorised by RRB.

What Happens If You Miss the Modification Window?

This section explains the consequences of not updating NCVT details within the given time frame, which is critical information for any eligible candidate still undecided about acting.

Missing this window has direct consequences for a CCAA candidate's selection prospects. If you do not update your certificate details and marks during the 17–23 June period, you will not be treated as a "CCAA Trained in Railway Establishment possessing NAC granted by NCVT." As a result, you will:

  • Lose the NCVT marks weightage benefit in the final merit list
  • Not be considered under the CCAA quota for this benefit
  • Likely be required to appear for the Physical Efficiency Test (PET), which CCAA candidates would otherwise be exempt from

Given how competitive RRB Group D recruitment is, losing either of these advantages can materially affect your final selection chances. There is no indication of any extension beyond 23 June 2026, so candidates are advised not to wait until the last day.

Will NCVT Details Be Verified Later?

This short section addresses a common follow-up concern: whether the information submitted now will be checked later in the process.

Yes. As per the official notice, all NCVT examination details filled in by candidates during this modification window will be verified at the Document Verification (DV) stage. Candidature remains subject to the accuracy of the information submitted, so candidates should ensure that certificate numbers, marks, and dates exactly match their original NAC certificate and mark sheet before final submission.

Documents to Keep Ready

Having these documents on hand before you start the update process will make the modification quicker and reduce the risk of entry errors.

  • National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) issued by NCVT
  • NCVT mark sheet showing marks obtained
  • Proof of apprenticeship training duration
  • Railway Establishment training-related documents

Modification Window Closes 23 June 2026, 23:59 hrs

The Railway Recruitment Board (RRB) is expected to release the official exam date notice on rrbcdg.gov.in in July 2026, with the Computer Based Test (CBT 1) likely to be held in the 4th week of August 2026 across 200+ examination centres in 21 railway zones. This recruitment drive covers 22,195 Group D vacancies across posts such as Track Maintainer, Pointsman, Assistant, and others. Candidates who have been preparing for this exam must keep a close eye on the official RRB website for the latest updates on exam dates, city intimation slips, and admit card release.

RRB Group D CEN 09/2025 - Exam Overview

Before diving into the full exam schedule and shift timings, here is a quick overview of the RRB Group D 2026 recruitment. This table covers all key details a candidate needs to know about the examination.

Detail Information
Exam Name RRB Group D (Level 1)
Conducting Body Railway Recruitment Board (RRB)

Post Level Level 1 (7th CPC Pay Matrix)

Mode of Exam Computer Based Test (CBT)
Number of Shifts 3 Shifts per Day
Expected Exam Date August 2026 (Tentative)
Official Website rrbcdg.gov.in / rrbapply.gov.in

RRB Group D Posts Under CEN 09/2025

The RRB Group D recruitment under CEN 09/2025 covers multiple Level 1 posts in Indian Railways. Candidates selected through CBT 1, PET, and Document Verification will be posted to one of the following roles:

  • Track Maintainer Grade IV
  • Pointsman
  • Assistant (Workshop)
  • Assistant Loco Shed
  • Assistant Operations & BD
  • Assistant TL & AC

These are permanent central government jobs with pay under the 7th CPC Pay Matrix Level 1, making this one of the most sought-after recruitment drives in India every year.

RRB Group D Exam Date 2026 - When Will It Be Released?

The official RRB Group D Exam Date 2026 is expected to be released in July 2026 on the Railway Recruitment Board's official website. The CBT 1 exam is tentatively scheduled in the 4th week of August 2026. The exact dates will be published in an official notification that will include the full exam schedule, city-wise centre allocation, and shift details.

Key points to note:

  • The exam date notice will be uploaded on rrbcdg.gov.in and all regional RRB websites.
  • The City Intimation Slip will be released at least 10 days before the exam date.
  • The Admit Card (Hall Ticket) will be available for download a few days before the CBT 1 date.
  • Candidates must log in with their Registration Number and Date of Birth to access these documents.

RRB Group D Exam Schedule 2026 - Tentative Shift Timings

The RRB Group D CBT 1 examination will be conducted in three shifts daily across multiple exam centres. Below are the tentative shift timings for the Railway Level 1 exam 2026. PwBD (Persons with Benchmark Disability) candidates who are using a scribe will get an additional 30 minutes per shift.

Shift Exam Start Time Duration (General) Duration (PwBD with Scribe)
Shift 1 9:00 AM 90 minutes 120 minutes
Shift 2 12:45 PM 90 minutes 120 minutes
Shift 3 5:00 PM 90 minutes 120 minutes

The exam will be held in over 200 examination centres spread across 21 railway zones, including major cities like Kolkata, Mumbai, Chennai, Patna, Hyderabad, and more.

Is RRB Group D Exam 2026 Postponed?

Many candidates are concerned about a possible postponement of the RRB Group D exam based on the previous experience with CEN 08/2024, where the exam was rescheduled multiple times due to court cases, normalization controversies, and administrative reasons.

However, candidates should note that such delays are not a regular occurrence with every recruitment cycle. Currently, there is no official notice or announcement about any postponement of the CEN 09/2025 CBT 1 examination. Candidates are advised to:

  • Continue their preparation without interruption.
  • Regularly check the official RRB website for any updates.
  • Avoid relying on unverified social media sources for exam date information.

Stay calm and focus on building a strong preparation strategy rather than worrying about possible delays.

RRB Group D City Intimation Slip 2026

The City Intimation Slip is a pre-exam document that informs candidates about their allotted exam city and examination centre. This is different from the Admit Card and is released earlier to help candidates make travel and accommodation arrangements in advance.

Key facts about the RRB Group D City Intimation Slip 2026:

  • It will be released at least 10 days before the scheduled CBT 1 exam date.
  • Candidates can download it from the official regional RRB websites.
  • Login credentials required: Registration Number and Date of Birth.
  • The slip mentions the allotted exam city (not the exact centre address - that is on the admit card).

Candidates are strongly advised to download and check the city intimation slip as soon as it is released so they can plan their travel accordingly.

RRB Group D Admit Card 2026 - Hall Ticket Details

The RRB Group D Admit Card 2026 (Hall Ticket) for CEN 09/2025 CBT 1 will be released on the official RRB regional websites a few days before the exam. Candidates need to download and carry a printed copy of the admit card to the examination hall.

The RRB Group D Hall Ticket 2026 will contain:

  • Candidate's name and photograph
  • Registration number and roll number
  • Exam date, shift, and reporting time
  • Exam centre name and address
  • Important exam day instructions

Important: Candidates must carry a valid government-issued photo ID proof (Aadhaar, Voter ID, Passport, PAN Card, etc.) along with the admit card. Entry without a valid admit card will not be permitted.

RRB Group D Selection Process 2026

The RRB Group D CEN 09/2025 selection process involves three stages. Candidates must clear each stage to be considered for final appointment:

  1. Computer Based Test (CBT 1) - Online objective type exam of 90 minutes covering Mathematics, General Science, General Intelligence & Reasoning, and General Awareness.
  2. Physical Efficiency Test (PET) - A qualifying round that tests the physical fitness of shortlisted candidates.
  3. Document Verification & Medical Examination - Final stage where documents are verified and medical fitness is assessed as per Railway medical standards.

Merit lists are prepared based on CBT 1 scores, and PET is purely qualifying in nature.

RRB Group D Preparation Tips for CBT 1 2026

With the RRB Group D Exam Date 2026 approaching in August, candidates must now focus on revision, speed improvement, and managing exam-day stress. Here are proven preparation tips to maximize your score in CBT 1:

  • Revise core topics from Mathematics, General Science, Reasoning, and General Awareness daily. Focus especially on topics with high weightage in previous year papers.
  • Solve Mock Tests and Previous Year Question Papers regularly to improve time management and accuracy under exam conditions.
  • Avoid starting new topics at this late stage. Focus on strengthening weak areas within the syllabus you have already covered.
  • Prepare quick-revision notes with important formulas, science facts, current affairs, and GK points for the last-minute revision.
  • Follow a structured daily study plan that allocates time to each subject and includes regular breaks to avoid burnout.
  • Take care of your health - adequate sleep, a balanced diet, and regular light exercise will keep your mind sharp on exam day.
  • Check official RRB websites regularly for the latest announcements on exam dates, admit cards, and schedule changes.

  • After completing the online application, students must send a printed copy along with the original challan through registered post to the respective regional UPMSP office by June 27, 2026
  • The UPMSP has regional offices in Meerut, Bareilly, Prayagraj, Varanasi, and Gorakhpur.

  • To apply, one must fill out the online application form and obtain a printed copy of the Treasury Challan.
  • It must both be sent by registered post to the board office

MPPSC Assistant Research Officer Final Answer Key 2026 - Overview

MPPSC ARO Answer Key 2026 - Timeline So Far

This section walks through the sequence of events from the exam date to the final answer key release, helping candidates understand where the recruitment process currently stands. MPPSC first conducted the written examination, then released a provisional key for objections, and has now finalized the answers based on that feedback.

  • The written examination for Assistant Research Officer posts was held on 12 October 2025.
  • MPPSC published the provisional answer key on 27 May 2026, allowing candidates a short window to raise objections against any answer they believed was incorrect.
  • After reviewing the objections received, the Commission released the Final Answer Key on 16 June 2026.
  • Since this is the final key, no further objections can be raised against it.

How to Download the MPPSC ARO Final Answer Key 2026 PDF

This section gives a simple, step-by-step process to access the official PDF directly from the MPPSC website, since the answer key is only valid when downloaded from the source.

  1. Visit the official MPPSC website at mppsc.mp.gov.in.
  2. Go to the "Answer Key" or "What's New" section on the homepage.
  3. Look for the link titled "Final Answer Key – Assistant Research Officer Exam 2024."
  4. Click on the link to open or download the PDF.
  5. Save the file and cross-check it against your response sheet (OMR sheet) for accurate score calculation.

How to Calculate Your Score Using the Final Answer Key

This section explains the basic process candidates should follow to estimate their result using the final key and their saved response sheet, since MPPSC exams typically follow a fixed marking pattern with negative marking for wrong answers.

  • Match every answer in your response sheet with the corresponding answer in the final key.
  • Award marks for each correct answer as per the marking scheme mentioned in the official exam notification.
  • Deduct marks for incorrect answers as per the negative marking rule specified in the notification.
  • Leave unattempted questions unmarked, as they typically do not attract any penalty.

Candidates should refer to the detailed marking scheme published in the original MPPSC ARO notification for exact mark values, since this can vary across different MPPSC exams.

When Will the MPPSC ARO Result 2026 Be Declared?

This section addresses the most commonly asked question after a final answer key release: when will the result come out? With the final answer key now published on 16 June 2026, the MPPSC Assistant Research Officer Result is expected to be announced in the coming weeks, since the Commission generally processes and declares results soon after the final key is finalized. Candidates should keep checking the official website regularly, as MPPSC does not always announce an exact result date in advance.

Many candidates confuse the provisional and final answer keys, so it helps to understand how the two differ in purpose and finality before checking your score.

The provisional answer key is the first version released soon after the exam, allowing candidates a window to raise objections if they believe any answer is incorrect. The final answer key, on the other hand, is released only after MPPSC's subject experts review all objections received; it incorporates any corrections found valid and is treated as conclusive for result preparation. No further objections are entertained once the final key is published.

Aspect Provisional Answer Key Final Answer Key
Release Stage Immediately after the exam After objection review
Released On 29 November 2025 16 June 2026
Open to Objections Yes No
Used for Result No Yes

MPPSC Assistant Registrar Exam Pattern (Written Exam Structure)

Understanding the exam pattern helps candidates correctly match their responses against the answer key and estimate their probable score. As per the official exam plan, the Assistant Registrar selection process is based on a written examination followed by an interview.

Component Marks
Written Examination (Objective Type, OMR-based) 450
Interview 50
Total 500

The written exam is divided into two broad sections:

  • Section A: General Studies related to Madhya Pradesh (history, geography, polity, economy, and current affairs of MP)
  • Section B: Society management and administration-related topics, including relevant laws, financial management, and important Acts

The paper is objective (multiple-choice), marked on an OMR sheet, and includes negative marking for incorrect answers as per the official marking scheme.

How to Calculate Your Score Using the Final Answer Key

Once you have the final answer key PDF and your response sheet (OMR copy) ready, you can estimate your probable score before the official result is declared.

  • Match each of your marked responses against the correct option given in the final answer key
  • Add the marks for every correct answer as per the official marking scheme
  • Deduct marks for incorrect answers wherever negative marking applies
  • Leave unattempted questions unscored
  • Total the result to get your estimated written exam score

Keep in mind that this is only an estimate; your official score will be confirmed by MPPSC after evaluation.

What Happens After the Final Answer Key? (Result & Selection Process)

With the final answer key now published, the next major milestone for candidates is the declaration of results based on the written examination.

  • MPPSC will use the final answer key to evaluate all candidates' OMR responses
  • The written exam result, along with category-wise cut-off marks, will be announced on the official website
  • Candidates who clear the written exam cut-off will be shortlisted for the interview round
  • Final selection for the post of Assistant Registrar will be based on combined marks from the written exam and interview
  • A selection list and detailed marks list will be published once the entire process concludes

Candidates are advised to keep checking mppsc.mp.gov.in regularly, as MPPSC announces all subsequent updates, including results and interview schedules, on the same portal.

This article covers the direct PDF download link, important dates, the objection fee, and the step-by-step process to challenge any answer you believe is incorrect.

What Is the UKSSSC Graduate Level Answer Key 2026?

This section explains what the answer key is and why it matters for candidates who took the Graduate Level exam.

The UKSSSC Graduate Level Answer Key 2026 is the provisional set of correct answers released by the commission for the recruitment examination held on June 14, 2026. The exam was conducted for various graduate-level posts under Advertisement No. 70/U030/2025 and was held in a single shift from 11:00 AM to 1:00 PM. After the exam concluded, UKSSSC prepared and published the answer key for all four sets of the question paper Set A, Set B, Set C, and Set D allowing candidates to verify the correctness of their responses before final results are declared.

Since the answer key is provisional, it is not the final word on correct answers. UKSSSC has clearly stated that the key may be revised based on objections raised by candidates, which is why the objection window exists before the final answer key and result are prepared.

UKSSSC Graduate Level Answer Key 2026 PDF Download

This section explains where and how candidates can download the official answer key PDF.

Candidates can download the UKSSSC Graduate Level Answer Key 2026 PDF directly from the link below or through the official UKSSSC website. The PDF contains the provisional correct answers for all sets of the question paper.

UKSSSC Graduate Level Answer Key 2026 PDF Download Answer Key

To check the answer key directly on the official portal, candidates can also visit sssc.uk.gov.in and look for the answer key link under the relevant notification section, since UKSSSC periodically updates and hosts all answer keys on its own website.

UKSSSC Graduate Level Objection Window - Important Dates

This section lists the exact dates within which candidates can raise objections against the provisional answer key.

UKSSSC has opened a limited window for candidates to challenge any answer in the provisional key that they believe is incorrect. Missing this window means the objection will not be considered, so candidates should note these dates carefully.

  • Objection Start Date: June 17, 2026
  • Last Date to Submit Objections: June 21, 2026, up to 5:00 PM
  • Objections submitted after 5:00 PM on June 21, 2026, will not be accepted under any circumstances.

UKSSSC Answer Key Objection Fee 2026

This section explains how much candidates need to pay to raise an objection and how the payment process works.

UKSSSC requires candidates to pay a fee for every question they wish to object to. This fee structure is meant to ensure that only genuine, well-supported objections are submitted to the commission.

  • Objection Fee: ₹50 per question
  • Objections, along with the applicable fee, can only be submitted through the official online objection portal provided by UKSSSC. Offline or manual submissions are not accepted.

How to Raise an Objection Against the UKSSSC Graduate Level Answer Key 2026

This section outlines the guidelines candidates must follow while submitting an objection, as instructed by the commission.

UKSSSC has laid out clear instructions for the objection process to maintain transparency and ensure only valid claims are reviewed. Candidates raising an objection must:

  • Submit objections only through the official online portal no other mode is accepted.
  • Attach valid supporting documents or evidence to justify each objection raised.
  • Pay the required ₹50 fee for every question being objected to.
  • Submit all objections within the prescribed deadline, i.e., by 5:00 PM on June 21, 2026.

Once the objection window closes, UKSSSC will examine all the valid objections received and accordingly prepare and publish the final answer key.

What Happens After the Objection Period Ends?

This section explains the process that follows once candidates have submitted their objections.

After June 21, 2026, UKSSSC will review every objection submitted by candidates along with the supporting evidence provided. Based on this review, the commission will finalize the answer key, making corrections wherever an objection is found valid. The final answer key forms the basis on which the Graduate Level exam results will eventually be calculated and declared.

How to Check Your Score Using the Provisional Answer Key

This section explains the basic process candidates can follow to estimate their probable result using the released answer key.

While UKSSSC has not published a separate scorecard tool, candidates can manually estimate their performance by:

  1. Downloading the UKSSSC Graduate Level Answer Key 2026 PDF for their respective set (A, B, C, or D).
  2. Comparing their marked responses, ideally from their response sheet or memory-based recall, with the official answers in the PDF.
  3. Noting the number of correct and incorrect answers based on the answer key.
  4. Keeping track of any answers they wish to formally object to, along with proof, before the objection window closes.

Rajasthan PTET 2026 Marking Scheme and Exam Pattern

Before calculating an expected score, candidates need to understand exactly how marks are awarded across the four sections of the PTET paper. This section breaks down the question distribution, maximum marks, and the special scaled-marking rule that applies only to the Teaching Aptitude section.

The PTET 2026 exam consisted of 200 objective-type questions worth a combined 600 marks, divided equally across four sections of 50 questions each.

Section Topic Questions Maximum Marks
Section A Mental Ability 50 150
Section B Teaching Attitude & Aptitude 50 150
Section C General Awareness 50 150
Section D Language Proficiency (Hindi or English) 50 150
Total   200 600

For Sections A, C, and D, the marking is straightforward:

Answer Type Marks Awarded
Correct Answer +3
Wrong Answer 0 (no negative marking)
Unattempted 0

Section B (Teaching Attitude & Aptitude) uses a scaled marking approach instead of a simple right-or-wrong system, since some questions in this section can have more than one reasonably correct option:

Response Quality Marks Awarded
Most Appropriate Answer +3
Second Best Answer +2
Marginally Correct Answer +1
Completely Incorrect Answer 0

There is no negative marking anywhere in the PTET exam, so candidates lose nothing for an incorrect or skipped response.

How to Calculate Your Score Using the PTET Answer Key 2026

This section explains the simple formula candidates can use to estimate their probable PTET score once they've matched their responses against the answer key. Since there's no negative marking, the calculation mainly involves counting correct answers and multiplying by the marks-per-question value.

  1. Download the answer key PDF matching your booklet Set (A, B, C, or D).
  2. Go through your OMR response sheet or recall the options you marked for each question.
  3. Tally the total number of questions you answered correctly in Sections A, C, and D.
  4. For Section B, apply the scaled marking values (+3, +2, +1, or 0) based on how closely your chosen option matches the "most appropriate" answer.
  5. Add up the marks from all four sections to arrive at your estimated total score.

Formula for Sections A, C, and D: Estimated Score = Number of Correct Answers × 3

Correct Answers Marks per Question Estimated Score
120 3 360
150 3 450
180 3 540

Keep in mind that this is only a provisional estimate. Your final, official score will depend on the final answer key issued after all valid objections have been reviewed and incorporated.

How to Raise an Objection Against the PTET Answer Key 2026

This section details the complete process for challenging an answer in the provisional key, including the eligibility criteria, required documents, and the fee structure. Only candidates who actually appeared for the exam are permitted to file an objection.

If you believe any answer in the provisional key is incorrect, you can challenge it online during the objection window, which typically stays open for 3 to 4 days after the provisional key's release. Each objection must be backed by credible evidence from a recognised academic textbook personal notes, coaching material, or unverified online sources are not accepted as valid proof.

  1. Log in to the official VMOU PTET candidate portal using your application number and password.
  2. Open the "Question Objection" or "Objection Form" section for your course (2-Year or 4-Year B.Ed.).
  3. Select your booklet Set code and enter the exact question number you wish to challenge.
  4. Write a clear justification explaining why you believe the listed answer is wrong, and state the option you think is correct.
  5. Upload a scanned page from a standard textbook supporting your claim, along with the book's name, author, and edition.
  6. Pay the objection fee of ₹100 per question through net banking, debit card, or credit card.
  7. Submit the form and download the payment confirmation receipt for your records.

After the objection window closes, a subject-expert committee constituted by VMOU reviews every challenge. Objections found valid are incorporated into the final answer key, which then forms the basis for the official result.

What does the Asterisk (*) mean in the RPSC answer key?

Several questions across subjects carry an asterisk (*) mark in the RPSC Senior Teacher Final Answer Key 2026. This is an important notation that every candidate should understand before calculating their expected score.

An asterisk (*) in the RPSC answer key means that the particular question has been officially deleted by the Rajasthan Public Service Commission. All candidates who appeared for that paper will receive full marks for the deleted question, regardless of whether they attempted it or which option they chose. This is a standard practice followed by RPSC whenever a question is found to be ambiguous, incorrect, out of syllabus, or disputed during the answer key challenge process.

  • Final Score: Tally your correct answers and subtract deductions for wrong ones to get your estimated total score.

Subject-Wise Highlights from the Revised Answer Key (Set ZO3)

The UPSSSC Kanistha Sahayak Mains Exam covered five broad subject areas across 100 questions. Below is a subject-wise summary of the types of questions asked, directly sourced from the Master Set revised answer key (ZO3).

Hindi Language (Questions 1–30)

The Hindi section tested candidates on core grammar and vocabulary concepts. Topics covered in the exam included the number of vowels (Swarvarna) in Hindi, Sandhi-Viched (word splitting), types of Sandhi (such as Guna Sandhi), correct and incorrect word forms, synonyms and antonyms, idioms (Muhavare), proverbs (Lokoktiyan), Samas (compound words including Tatpurush Samas), Karak (grammatical cases including Apadan Karak), types of pronouns (Prashnvachak Sarvanam), types of sentences, and one-word substitutions.

General Mental Ability and Reasoning (Questions 31–45)

The reasoning section included analogy-based questions, odd one out from letter series, number-based coding problems, seating arrangement-based ranking questions, figure counting (number of squares in a given figure), sequence completion, coding-decoding (such as CALL = BZKK, find PEON), syllogism-based logical conclusions, and series completion (e.g., 3, 15, 35, 63, 99, ?).

General Knowledge and Current Affairs (Questions 46–60)

The GK section covered static and current affairs topics including the origin of the Ganga river (Gangotri Glacier), common domestic fuel (LPG), organ that pumps blood (Heart), Pokhran's historical significance (successful Atomic Bomb testing), the pandemic that spread in 2020 (Covid-19), the organization running India's space programmes (ISRO), the leader who launched the Quit India Movement (Mahatma Gandhi), the sector employing most Indians (Agriculture), currency note issuing authority in India (Reserve Bank of India), the Jallianwala Bagh Massacre location (Amritsar, Punjab), the Salt Satyagraha movement (Civil Disobedience Movement), the song popular during the Swadeshi Movement (Vande Mataram), the state with rich coal deposits (Chhattisgarh), India's Chief Election Commissioner in 2025 (Gyanesh Kumar), and the country from which India purchased Rafale-M jets in 2025 (None of the above).

Computer Knowledge and Digital Literacy (Questions 61–80)

The computer section tested candidates on the first version of the Internet (ARPANET, 1969), matching software to categories (Microsoft Word = Word Processor, Linux = Operating System, Google Chrome = Web Browser, Photoshop = Image Editing Software), arranging computers by processing power (Micro, Mini, Mainframe, Super), the primary purpose of USB (connecting external devices and transferring data), the father of computers (Charles Babbage), e-Governance (using the Internet to provide government services), the hardware used to print large maps and posters (Plotter), a digital wallet (Paytm), FASTag (automatic toll payment without stopping), the Internet as a network of globally connected computers, examples of structured data (Excel), AI examples (ChatGPT), popular AI voice assistants (Siri), and IoT/Big Data/Deep Learning/AI matching.

Uttar Pradesh Special GK (Questions 81–100)

The UP-specific section included questions on the Lower Ganga Canal (built in 1878, originates at Narora in Bulandshahr district), the Mahajanapad-Capital pair not correctly matched (Asmak – Virat), the dynasty that replaced the Shunga dynasty in Magadh (Kanva dynasty), districts in Azamgarh Division (Mau, Ballia), Babur's victory at the Battle of Khanwa 1527 (Rana Sanga of Mewar), the Battle of Ghaghara (1529), the date of approval of UP Tourism Policy 2022 (16 November 2022), location of Chota Imambara and Roomi Darwaza (Lucknow), Kaimur Wildlife Sanctuary location (Sonbhadra), plateaus forming UP's southern frontier (Bundelkhand and Baghelkhand), Archaean rocks found in (Sonbhadra and Lalitpur), IST facts (82.5° east longitude, passes through Mirzapur), the "Sorrow of Gorakhpur" river (Rapti), incorrectly matched airport (Kalyanpur International Airport – Aligarh), GNIDA full form (Greater Noida Industrial Development Authority), Operation Dronagiri 2024 states (UP, Haryana, Assam, Andhra Pradesh, Maharashtra), Kashi Tamil Sangamam (KTS) 3.0 location (Varanasi, Feb 2025), UP Budget 2025-26 (Rs. 8,08,736.06 crore), veteran hockey player from Varanasi (Lalit Upadhyay), and Tiger Claw 2025 exercise (concluded at Garud Regimental Training Center, UP).

How to Calculate Your Score Using the Revised Answer Key

  • Brand Reputation Management: Monitoring, managing, and nurturing Base.com's brand image and user reviews across partner platforms and review sites (e.g., Shopify App Store, Trustpilot)

  • Mindset & Soft Skills: Highly proactive, hands-on approach, and resourceful. You have strong self-management skills and the ability to navigate a fast-paced environment independently
  • Drive: A genuine desire to learn, grow, and build the role from the ground up, taking true ownership of the Italian marketing operations

Benefits

  • Be a part of a global, fast-scaling e-commerce SaaS company with a leading tech product
  • Be a key player in Base.com's Italian market expansion

About The Role

Weâre hiring Leapâs Founding Designer: the person who will define how Leap shows up to patients and families.

This is a rare design opportunity. Leap helps people access complex, high-cost therapies at moments that are often stressful, confusing, and clinically serious. Patients may be hearing from us for the first time while navigating a new diagnosis, an unfamiliar treatment, or a healthcare system that has already made them feel lost. Great design can make the difference between hesitation and action.

Your first priority will be Member Growth. Youâll help create the campaigns and member communications that introduce Leap, earn trust quickly, and make the next step feel clear. But this is not just a campaign design role. The larger mandate is to shape the patient-facing experience: how people discover Leap, understand their options, schedule care, prepare for treatment, stay engaged, and come back when they need support.

Weâre looking for someone who can move fluidly between strategy and execution. One day, you may be mapping a patient journey or learning from a Care Guide where members get stuck. The next, you may be designing a landing page, improving a direct mail concept, tightening a message hierarchy, or building a reusable pattern the whole team can use. The work will be hands-on, but the impact should be company-wide.

You do not need to be a copywriter, researcher, product manager, or front-end developer. But you should have the range to be an exceptional creative partner across all of those disciplines: someone with strong user judgment, excellent design taste, clear communication, modern production fluency, and the ability to bring structure to ambiguous problems.

  • Build the systems that let great design scale. Youâll create reusable patterns, components, templates, QA processes, AI-assisted workflows, and production standards across web, email, direct mail, print, swag, educational materials, and internal workflows.

  • Turn healthcare complexity into simple, responsible experiences. Leap operates in a category that is clinically nuanced, emotionally sensitive, and operationally complex. Youâll make difficult information easier to understand without oversimplifying, overpromising, or creating unnecessary anxiety.
  • Act as a creative lead and hands-on maker. Youâll shape briefs, guide visual systems, improve message hierarchy, coordinate copy, illustration, motion, web, lifecycle, and vendor partners as needed, and still stay close enough to the work to design and produce polished, production-ready assets yourself.

What Weâre Looking For

  • A broad designer with strong patient/customer experience judgment You know how to simplify complexity, reduce friction, build trust quickly, and make the next step feel obvious for people making meaningful decisions. Youâve done this specifically in lifecycle marketing, member engagement, patient education, or high-consideration consumer decisions.
  • Strong product, UX, and research instincts. You can map journeys, structure information, design flows, talk to users and internal teams, identify patterns, and translate qualitative insight into better experiences.
  • Direct-response and growth design experience. You have designed creative where success was measured by conversion, activation, enrollment, response rate, lead generation, or another measurable action.
  • Excellent visual design craft and message hierarchy. Your work is clean, thoughtful, and disciplined. You know how to use hierarchy, typography, layout, imagery, pacing, narrative, headlines, and CTAs to guide attention and drive action.

  • Print, digital, and modern production fluency. You understand what it takes to get direct mail to press, launch landing pages, design for email constraints, QA assets, and work effectively with vendors and channel owners. You are fluent in contemporary design tools and have strong opinions about how AI is changing creative workflows.
  • Comfortable directing outside creative talent. You know how to brief, manage, and review work from agencies and contractors, giving clear direction, holding the line on quality and brand, and keeping projects on schedule even when youâre the only in-house designer.
  • High agency, low ego, and comfort with complexity. You can create structure from ambiguity, move fast, explain your decisions clearly, incorporate feedback across functions, and design in regulated, emotionally sensitive environments where accuracy, trust, and nuance matter.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience in healthcare, benefits, insurance, pharmacy, financial services, or another regulated category.
  • Experience with HubSpot, Customer.io, Braze, Iterable, Mailchimp, Webflow, Framer, or similar marketing, lifecycle, and landing-page tools.

Role Snapshot

Powering Trade For The Emerging Cannabis Industry

 

Distru is the #1 ERP in the Cannabis Industry with $3B in annual sales processed through our platform! We are a fully remote and global team building a software platform to streamline the supply chain for the cannabis industry. Most of the top cannabis brands and distributors across the United States use our software to manage their entire operation and stay compliant.

 

As part of our next phase of growth, last year we launched Distru Commerce; a wholesale platform that extends our ERP into the B2B marketplace layer, giving operators a single system to manage their internal operations and their external wholesale sales channels in one fully integrated system. But we're not stopping here. AI is now a core part of how we build and where we're placing our bets. The AI Order Agent is live and already changing how our customers operate: buyers can submit orders from any source and any format saving time spent on manual data entry. That's one piece of a bigger picture: using AI to take the repetitive, heavy-lifting work out of running an ERP so operators can focus on running their business. 

 

We take a tremendous amount of pride in our culture and have 5/5 stars on Glassdoor because we truly care about our people. We are stable, profitable, and heavily investing in growing new product lines to expand our reach. Our investors include Felicis Ventures, Global Founders Capital, Poseidon Asset Management, and Village Global who have funded companies such as Shopify, Cruise, HelloFresh, Facebook, Slack, and Opendoor.

 

 

The Opportunity

We're looking for an AI-forward Product Manager who thinks in systems, ships with conviction, and sees AI not as a feature layer but as a product foundation. This role will take significant ownership of parts of our core ERP, Distru Commerce, and our new AI-native product features. You'll report directly to the CTO and work side-by-side with the rest of the product team, engineering, and design.

Distru is at an inflection point. We have deep market penetration in cannabis ERP, a new commerce layer live and growing, and a roadmap that's increasingly AI-native. The PM who takes this role will own a meaningful piece of that roadmap; not just the feature backlog, but the design of how AI agents integrate into user workflows, where automation belongs, and where human judgment must stay front and center.

This is a high-ownership role at a company that ships weekly and cares about getting it right. You'll work directly with the C-suite, set the bar for what great product looks like inside Distru, and help us build the operating system for an entire industry.

 

Our Team Culture

 

Rather than us defining our culture, check out what the team has to say! 

\n


What You'll Own

Own the Product Roadmap

  • Define and execute on the product roadmap
  • Maintain a clear, prioritized roadmap. Communicate timelines, risks, and tradeoffs proactively
  • Write PRDs and work in tandem with engineers to understand and synthesize specific customer requests into meaningful features that improve the system at large
  • Integrate AI agents into the Distru user workflow

Own the Product Lifecycle

  • Design interaction patterns for AI-assisted planning, spec writing, requirements analysis, and stakeholder communication
  • Define when the AI suggests, when it automates, and when it stays silent â and ship the affordances that make this obvious to users

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Work closely with engineering, CS, sales and marketing. You are the bridge that pulls insights from all of these departments together and ensures the product is moving in the right direction


What We're Looking For

Must-Haves 

  • 5+ years in tech product management
  • You've owned and shipped complex features end-to-end â from ambiguous problem statement to launched feature with measurable outcomes
  • Demonstrated AI fluency across three dimensions:
    • Tool fluency: you know failure modes, context windows, the LLM ecosystem
    • Workflow fluency: you know what to automate vs. keep human, and optimize for speed, correctness and scalability
    • Product fluency: you know the difference between AI that earns its place in a product and AI that was bolted on to check a box. You've shipped the former.
  • Hands-on experience with product management tools. You've lived inside Jira, Linear, Notion, or similar; you know where the friction lives because you've felt it
  • Technical fluency: you can read API docs, understand context windows, and write specs engineers and AI agents can build from
  • Strong prioritization instincts. You can distinguish urgent from important and hold the line on scope
  • Clear communication. Most of your work product starts as written artifacts: PRDs, decision memos, spec documents

Nice-to-Haves 

  • Background in supply chain, ERP, CRM, B2B marketplaces, or accounting software
  • Experience with UX design
  • Familiarity with agentic systems and multi-agent orchestration
  • Experience using Claude Code or similar tools to build products independently
  • Early-stage startup experience (sub-50 headcount)


Our Interview Process
  1. Initial Screen: A conversation about your background, your take on AI-forward PM, and mutual fit
  2. Product Work Session: A take-home prompt sent you work on with live interactions with the Distru team
  3. Product Work Session Review: A conversation around your product work submission where you and the Distru team dive deeper into your thoughts and decisions
  4. Final Interview: Call with our CEO to determine final fit

This may involve developing new businesses, expanding into new territories and establishing new dealer network. Develops and implements sales strategies and objectives. Has in-depth knowledge for the products responsible, Positive relationships with HCPs, a good understanding of other J&J products and service offerings. Understands & empathizes with customer's needs and maintains sharp competitive knowledge and market trends. Through effective leadership, inspires leads, directs, motivates, coaches and develops sales team to achieve/exceed sales target. Works to develop long-term positive customer relationships to achieve customer delight, and build loyalty and confidence in J&J Medical as a preferred supplier.

  • Analyse sales reports to proactively find opportunities and at risk, re-prioritize resources to maximise sales opportunities

  • Lead MDAs and Professional Education programs with HCPs for the region

Region Management

  • In-depth understanding of current and future customers needs and translate them into sales opportunities with the help of the team
  • Direct coverage expansion and conversion.
  • Work in the field with each team member to achieve effective coverage of key accounts; maintain high level of customer rapport and reinforce company's commitment to superior customer services
  • Analyze competitive market environment based on insights of competitor's structure, culture, personnel, distribution, capabilities and weaknesses, as well as detailed knowledge of customer's support and preferences for competitive products and services
  • Based on customers short and long term needs, competitive threats/environment, and present/extrapolated market trends, conduct SWOT analysis for the respective territory
  • Based on results of SWOT analysis, set direction, and plans for the territory/region/key accounts, to achieve dept/functional goals; communicate plans and ensure they are understood by the team and related sales/marketing groups
  • Develop a sales plan for each territory; set realistic attainable sales objectives by customer and product groups, and by monthly/quarterly/annual targets
  • Has expert knowledge of sales process and expert selling skills to make effective sales call, to teach others and to improve current selling process
  • Keen understanding of internal organization (J&J) resources, priorities and needs, relating to the business operations and achievement of sales plan
  • Administrative responsibilities like HCC, A&SP and other activities with help of branch assistant.

Customer Satisfaction

  • Develop and maintain positive relationships with all levels of customers

  • Craft innovative customer support services/tender arrangements including E-initiatives and efficient use of company services

  • Ensure compliance with the "Customer Complaints Procedure"; customer issues/ complaints are attended to promptly and professionally to customer's satisfaction
  • Ensure appropriate problem solving strategies are used by sales team when dealing with product or service difficulties

Internal Business Process

  • Handle internal relationships and processes enabling flexibility and responsiveness in drawing on internal specialists, accessing information and support as needed
  • Optimise sales results through close alignment and cooperation with Franchise Marketing team
  • Use internal resources and own understanding of supply chain processes and principles of Health Economics as a basis for finding opportunities for service innovation
  • Work with/involve appropriate functions when developing sales incentives programs
  • Efficiently handle operating expenses, (transportation, A&P, entertainment, travel) while ensuring balanced efficiency
  • Supervise inventory level to meet inventory level objectives; ensure inventory levels are adequate in major product categories in accordance with inventory objectives

Self-Development

  • Identify specific actions to improve job performance in specific areas
  • Participate in nominated training programs
  • Active self-learning strategies to maintain knowledge
  • Focused effort to achieve high levels of performance in knowledge tests and proficiency assessments related to training
  • Develops talent & team by identifying their development areas, providing timely feedback and guiding their progress and promotes diversity.

Qualifications

  • Post-graduation or Graduation Degree
  • Proven experience of 7+ years in Medical Devices.
  • Must have experience in Government tenders and contracts. Should have handled both autonomous and corporation Government business with understanding of GEM
  • Exposure to Trade/retail markets and corporate accounts as well.
  • Capital selling experience is also preferred.

Required Skills

Preferred Skills:

Brand Positioning Strategy, Communication, Competitive Landscape Analysis, Compliance Management, Customer Centricity, Customer Experience Management, Incentive Policy, Procedures, and Quotas, Industry Analysis, Market Opportunity Assessment, Problem Solving, Profit and Loss (P&L) Management, Project Management, Sales Prospecting, Strategic Sales Planning, Strategic Thinking, Sustainable Procurement, Vendor Selection

Role Snapshot
At peopleworth, we support work where people and performance thrive. As part of our Employer Group, we work with a variety of forward-thinking partners and are excited to share this opportunity that sits within our growing group.

We are seeking an experienced Strategic Partnerships Director to lead and strengthen key partner relationships, drive operational excellence, and support the successful delivery of strategic education-focused initiatives. This role is ideal for a commercially minded relationship leader who combines strong account management capabilities with project coordination expertise and a passion for delivering exceptional stakeholder outcomes.

Role Overview

The Strategic Partnerships Director is responsible for managing and developing strategic partner relationships while ensuring the successful coordination and delivery of activities across multiple stakeholders. The role focuses on governance, reporting, risk management, stakeholder engagement, and identifying opportunities to strengthen long-term partnerships and support sustainable growth.

Working closely with internal teams and senior external stakeholders, you will act as a trusted advisor, ensuring commitments are delivered, issues are resolved efficiently, and partnership objectives are achieved.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage strategic partner relationships and act as a trusted point of contact for senior stakeholders
  • Support the overall success of partnership engagements through proactive account management and stakeholder collaboration
  • Oversee operational planning, risk management, and delivery activities across key phases of partner engagements
  • Identify, manage, and resolve escalated issues while ensuring timely communication and effective outcomes
  • Coordinate cross functional teams to ensure commitments are delivered and activities remain aligned with partnership objectives
  • Prepare and present governance reports, business reviews, and performance updates for internal and external stakeholders
  • Provide strategic insights and recommendations to improve partnership performance and long-term value creation
  • Coach and guide internal teams on effective partner engagement practices and account management approaches
  • Develop a deep understanding of partner objectives and identify opportunities to expand support and strengthen relationships
  • Contribute to the development and improvement of partnership management processes, systems, and operational frameworks

Requirements

  • Demonstrated experience in senior account management, partnership management, or client relationship leadership roles
  • Minimum two years of experience managing key accounts, strategic partnerships, or complex stakeholder relationships
  • Experience coordinating projects involving multiple internal and external stakeholders
  • Strong client service orientation with a proven ability to build productive and trusted relationships
  • Knowledge of digital education, online learning, higher education, or related sectors would be advantageous
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to prepare reports, presentations, and proposals
  • Strong organisational skills with exceptional attention to detail and the ability to manage competing priorities
  • Experience working independently while effectively collaborating with geographically distributed teams
  • Demonstrated problem solving, decision making, and risk management capabilities
  • Commitment to continuous learning, improvement, and professional development

Benefits

Collaborative, people-centred performance culture.

Opportunities to grow in a fast-paced environment.

Exposure to strategic stakeholder engagement and partnership leadership opportunities.

Opportunity to work with diverse teams across multiple regions and time zones.

Our Recruitment Process

The peopleworth Employer Group follows a fair, transparent, and multi-stage recruitment process designed to ensure mutual fit.

  • Application Submission: Complete the online form and answer brief application questions.
  • Initial Screening: Your application is reviewed for role alignment; successful candidates move to the longlist.
  • Video Interview Stage: You'll be invited to record short responses to 3-4 role-specific questions.
  • Live Interviews: Shortlisted candidates join first-round interviews (and, where applicable, second or third rounds depending on the role).
  • Final Shortlist & Verification: Reference and background checks are completed.
  • Offer & Contracting: Successful candidates receive formal offers and contract documents.
  • Pre-boarding & Onboarding: Once accepted, you'll complete a pre-boarding process before officially joining your employing organisation within the Employer Group.

Throughout every stage, we value clear communication, respectful engagement, and timely feedback.
